source_assessment: Earcons awaits session preparation before actual player preparation/play and rechecks cancellation, current request/channel, enabled state, generation and monotonic age. Global suspension and metronome stop invalidate pending feedback; independent multiplier/judgment channels remain compatible.

Cached scheduled grants remain time-gated at canonical access reads, invalid supplied windows fail closed, unit2 remains independent, and effective grant snapshots invalidate retained song layouts. Access publication requests redraw without terminating a running take.

Watch capture instrumentation remains DEBUG-only; release initialization retains Today and ordinary WatchConnectivity activation. UUID/revision/language/page/state and image validation reject stale captures; actual simulator execution and visual media acceptance remain required.
The localization workflow change preserves pipefail while retaining full export diagnostics; it does not suppress a failing xcodebuild exit status.

Independent store checks pass and current metadata preserves release_ready=false. Listing descriptions distinguish live microphone privacy from deliberately imported recordings and omit the disabled Game Center promise.

Policy synchronization is approved for source consistency: song requests use the normal install/session identifiers, acknowledge only accepted HTTP delivery and allow retry on failure; attribution properties exclude country/region and arbitrary response fields; revocation cancels tracked HTTP tasks and invalidates retries/results while an already-running synchronous token provider remains uncancellable; default Game Center build setting is NO. Generated HTML contains the corrected policy. This approval does not establish legal certification or deployed-byte identity.

nonblocking_advisories.observation: The openingsChanged sink redraws app observers but does not invoke republishWidgetsSoon. WidgetLibrary persists LessonAccess-derived standing, so widget song badges can remain stale after a same-day remote grant/revocation until the next normal publish. Canonical entry access still rechecks policy; no access bypass was identified.
nonblocking_advisories.suggestion: Consider forwarding access changes to the existing widget republisher; retain this as an explicit limitation otherwise.

independently_executed_verification.result: 50 listing locales checked, zero draft validation problems

limitations: Windows-only review: no Swift/Xcode typecheck, native build, XCTest, simulator, hardware, audio timing/interruption, Watch capture or visual media execution was performed.

Focused source/test review and prior per-area receipts do not establish full App Store readiness. Hosted native CI must run against final committed bytes, and device/media/account gates remain separate.
Policy approval covers local source consistency only. No policy deployment, public endpoint verification, Apple operation, commit or implementation mutation was performed by this reviewer.
